id: 650-第二次蒂卡爾-卡拉克穆爾戰爭
theater: 佩滕盆地蒂卡爾至卡拉克穆爾

battle.name: 第二次蒂卡爾-卡拉克穆爾戰爭
battle.theater: 佩滕盆地蒂卡爾至卡拉克穆爾
battle.brief: 公元650年，卡拉克穆爾王卡爾通·希克斯大軍沿佩滕盆地堤道攻入蒂卡爾，此事刻在公元751年立起的31號碑上，是瑪雅石刻中極罕見的敗績記錄。卡面那面羅馬方陣盾並未隨軍而至；瑪雅戰士靠棉甲、木盾與投矛器，扮演了盾牆在同一場攻城裡的角色。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場戰爭爆發於公元650年前後，屬瑪雅古典期的城邦衝突，戰線在今貝里斯西部瓦卡高原與瓜地馬拉東北部沼澤地之間。交戰的兩方，一邊是蒂卡爾城邦及其原有的附庸與盟城網絡，另一邊是卡拉克穆爾城邦（古名烏克斯維察，意為三山）以及背後支持它的北方蛇族王室。中繼點是納蘭霍，位於兩城之間的堤道線上，誰控制納蘭霍，往往決定誰能把兵力送到對方城牆下。兩邊都不是常備軍國家：兵員由城邦領袖依村社徵召，貴族與祭司團隊隨王出行，平民戰士自備武器與口糧，指揮系統極簡，通常由一位統帥在前，勝負取決於王室的宗族聯盟與盟城是否跟從，以及出征儀式與天象時序是否完成。城邦內部設有 batab（即受委任的城邑首長）管轄附庸，並以 k'uhul 等祭祀官職維持秩序，戰時各城邑首長領兵匯合。兩邊都沒有羅馬式的常備兵團與固定的攻城器械庫，戰爭規模取決於有多少城邦願意出兵，以及旱季還剩多少糧食可以帶上路。
countriesEn: This war broke out around AD 650 in the Classic Maya period, on a front that ran from the Vaca Plateau of western Belize to the marshes of north-eastern present-day Guatemala. On one side stood Tikal, together with the network of subordinate towns and allies it had held since the sixth century; on the other stood Caracol, the city-state whose ancient name was Uxwitza, Three Hills, backed by the Snake royal house of the north. The hinge between them was Naranjo, standing on the causeway line between the two cities, and whoever held Naranjo usually decided who could march men to the other side's walls. Neither side was a standing-army state. Levies were raised by the city rulers from village communities, nobles and priestly groups travelled with the king, commoner warriors brought their own weapons and rations, and command was minimal: normally a single war leader in the field. The outcome turned on the kinship alliances of the ruling houses, on whether allied towns followed, and on whether the ritual calendar and the astrological timing of the campaign had been properly observed. Inside each city-state there were batab, the appointed governors of dependent towns, while ritual offices such as k'uhul kept the order; in wartime the governors of the towns led their contingents to a rendezvous. Both sides lacked a Roman-style professional corps and a fixed stockpile of siege engines: the scale of the war was decided by how many towns were prepared to send men, and by how much food the dry season still held.
people: 留下姓名的當事人並不多，但這一次留下了一件關鍵的物證。卡拉克穆爾方面的統帥是卡爾通·希克斯（K'altuun Hix，水蓮美洲豹），約公元629至688年在位；卡拉克穆爾王室的水蓮美洲豹徽記正是這位君主的象徵，他在位期間把城邦推到鼎盛，並主持了公元650年對蒂卡爾的攻擊。蒂卡爾方面，事發時在位的是卡克·蒂利烏·查·約帕阿特（K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat，約公元629至669年在位）；蒂卡爾真正的復國則是在其後繼者西亞赫·查·卡威爾二世（Siyaj Chan K'awiil II）治下完成，這位君主在公元751年下令立起蒂卡爾31號碑，把一百年前那場敗績刻在石頭上。北方蛇族王室的支撐來自大·尤克諾姆（Yuknoom the Great，公元636至686年執掌北方蛇族王室的君主），他的出兵使佩滕盆地的城邦天平倒向瓦卡高原。今日能讀懂這場戰爭，靠的是一批現代學者：普羅庫里亞科娃對長紀年曆與王名的破譯，阿倫．蔡斯與黛安．蔡斯自1985年起主持的卡拉克穆爾考古計畫，1982至1994年威廉．福蘭在卡拉克穆爾主持的發掘，以及李薩．特雷德勒等人2017年發表於《科學》雜誌的蒂卡爾水庫沉積物研究，把佩滕盆地的乾旱時序與城邦崩解的時間對上了起來。蒂卡爾31號碑的保護與重新立起，也讓這段被敗績記錄的歷史重新回到公眾視線。
peopleEn: Few of the actors left a name behind, but this time they left a crucial piece of evidence. The commander on the Caracol side was K'altuun Hix, the Water Lily Jaguar, in power from about AD 629 to 688. The water lily jaguar emblem of the Caracol royal house was that ruler's sign; during his reign he carried the city-state to its height and led the attack on Tikal in AD 650. On the Tikal side the ruler in office when it happened was K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat, from about AD 629 to 669; Tikal's real recovery came under his successor Siyaj Chan K'awiil II, who in AD 751 ordered the erection of Stela 31 at Tikal, cutting a defeat of a century earlier into stone. Support from the northern Snake royal house came from Yuknoom the Great, ruler of that house from AD 636 to 686, whose intervention tipped the balance of the Peten city-states toward the Vaca Plateau. What makes this war readable today is a body of modern scholarship: Tatiana Proskouriakoff's decipherment of the Long Count and the royal names, the Caracol Archaeological Project directed by Arlen Chase and Diane Chase from 1985, William Folan's excavations at Caracol between 1982 and 1994, and the reservoir sediment work led by Lisa Treidler and colleagues, published in Science in 2017, which tied the drought sequence in the Peten to the timing of the city-states' collapse. The conservation and re-erection of Stela 31 also brought this history, recorded as a defeat, back into public view.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬方陣盾並未隨軍進入佩滕盆地。卡面那面標示為公元前100年的羅馬方陣盾（scutum），是共和末期至帝國時期步兵的標準防具：木框蒙皮，約高一百零五厘米、寬五十五至六十厘米，凸面弧度讓箭矢偏離，邊緣有金屬包邊與縱向肋條，盾背有握把，盾面留出印記區以打上軍徽，重量約十公斤上下。它的價值不在厚度而在體系：羅馬步兵把盾緣互相咬合成整條線，進攻時整列向前推，抵禦投射物時再疊成龜甲陣（testudo），靠的是人與盾的結構，而不是單件裝備的檔次。瑪雅一方沒有這種制式大盾，也沒有盾緣咬合的整體防線。公元650年真正出現在佩滕盆地的裝備是：嵌燧石或黑曜石刃的木劍（macuahuitl，晚期古典期已漸被推刺式長矛取代）、投矛器（atlatl）配短矛與石鏃、弓與箭、羊毛編的彈弓、小型木盾與鹿皮蒙面的圓盾，以及棉絮甲（以棉絮夾在織物之間，分較軟的 ich' 與較厚的 huitsi）；頭部有以硬化布料製成的頭盔，手持石斧（hacha）與陶錘。攻城與野戰另有兩個要命的工具：一是切斷白灰岩堤道（sacbe），令對方城市失去陸路交通與運兵能力；二是奪取城外的蓄水池（aguada）與地下水窖（chultun），在旱季直接掐住守軍的飲水。交通靠步行與獨木舟，糧食是玉米、豆類與可可，一支只帶數日口糧的遠征軍必須在雨季前打完收官。
kitsEn: The Roman scutum on the card did not travel into the Peten basin with any army. The shield on the card, dated to 100 BC, is the standard infantry defence of the late Republic and the Empire: a wooden frame covered in hide, roughly 105 centimetres high and 55 to 60 wide, with a convex face that deflected missiles, metal edging and vertical ribs, a grip on the inside, and a flat area on the front reserved for stamping the unit emblem; it weighed around ten kilograms. Its worth lay in the system rather than in thickness: Roman infantry locked shield rim against shield rim to make a continuous line, pressed forward in that formation when attacking, and folded into the testudo tortoise when resisting missiles, relying on the structure of men and shields rather than on the grade of any single piece. The Maya had no such standard large shield and no continuous line built from interlocking rims. What actually stood up in the Peten basin in AD 650 was: the macuahuitl, a wooden sword edged with flint or obsidian blades, gradually displaced in the late Classic period by thrusting spears; the atlatl dart thrower with short spears and stone points; bow and arrow; the woven sling; small wooden shields and round shields faced with deerskin; and cotton armour, with cotton batting quilted between layers of cloth, in a softer type called ich' and a heavier one called huitsi. Heads were protected by helmets of hardened fabric, and the hand carried stone axes, the hacha, and stone or ceramic clubs. Two further tools mattered more in the field than in the siege: cutting the white limestone causeways, the sacbeob, to strangle the enemy's land communication and troop movement; and seizing the reservoirs, the aguadas, and the underground cisterns, the chultunes, outside the city, which in the dry season cut off the defenders' drinking water at the source. Movement was on foot and by dugout canoe, and the food was maize, beans and cacao, so a field army carrying only a few days of rations had to finish its campaign before the rains began.
tactics: 瑪雅城邦之間的戰爭有一套固定程序，順序大致如下。第一步是儀式定案：由祭司團隊依日誌與天象排出星戰的時序，國王與貴族先行禁食、刺血放血、焚香，舉行玉米神相關的儀式取得神聖許可，出兵日期才被確定；德雷士登手抄本裡記載的出征與宿營方位，就是這套程序的同期文件。第二步是集結與行軍：各附庸城邦的首長領兵，在旱季沿白灰岩堤道與獸道合流，遠征只帶數日口糧，路上靠徵召與掠奪補充。第三步是接戰：進攻方先以投矛器、彈弓與弓箭覆蓋守軍所在的高處台基與屋頂，點燃硬木屋架製造煙幕，再以持斧者與長矛手沿石階攀上台面展開近身格鬥，美洲豹戰士則在亂局中突入破壞。第四步是善後：得手方通常不長期佔領，而是奪取石碑、祭器、玉米與人口作為戰利品，並在城內立碑記錄一次斧戰，這是瑪雅城邦戰爭的通則，蒂卡爾31號碑所刻的正是這樣一次征服的記錄。卡面那面方陣盾所代表的整條線互相咬合的防線，在蒂卡爾攻防裡並無對應物：守方依靠建築台階的縱深、人數與地形，進攻方依靠投射物覆蓋與火，而不是盾牆。羅馬人面對高大結實的防禦工事，靠龜甲陣逼近再破牆；瑪雅人在佩滕盆地靠的是斷堤道、奪水源與焚燒，兩套邏輯面對的是不同的城市形制。
tacticsEn: Maya wars between city-states followed a fixed procedure, roughly in this order. First, ritual set the date: priestly teams read the day books and the sky to fix the timing of the star war, and the king and the nobles fasted, drew blood and burned incense, performing the maize-god rituals that granted sacred permission before a departure date could be chosen; the campaigns and camp dispositions recorded in the Dresden Codex are contemporary documents of exactly this procedure. Second, muster and march: the governors of the dependent towns led their contingents, which converged along the limestone causeways and the game trails in the dry season, carrying only a few days of rations and living off requisition and plunder on the way. Third, contact: the attackers covered the heights where the defenders stood, the platform mounds and the roofs, with atlatl darts, sling stones and arrows, set fire to the hardwood roof frames to make smoke, and then brought axe-men and spearmen up the stone stairways to fight at close quarters on the platforms, while jaguar warriors broke through the confusion. Fourth, the settlement: the victors normally did not occupy the place for long but took away stelae, ritual vessels, maize and people as spoil, and raised a monument in the city recording a ch'ak, a conquest; that was the general rule for Maya interstate war, and what Stela 31 at Tikal records is precisely such a conquest. The interlocking shield line that the scutum on the card stands for has no counterpart in the fighting over Tikal: the defenders relied on the depth of the platform stairways, on numbers and on terrain, while the attackers relied on covering fire and fire, not on a shield wall. Romans facing tall, massive fortifications advanced under the testudo and then broke the wall; the Maya in the Peten basin cut causeways, seized water and burned. The two systems of logic faced two different forms of city.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，以下幾個屬於硬證據。距離：卡拉克穆爾至蒂卡爾約七十六公里，納蘭霍位於兩者之間，約各四十二公里。年代：戰役本身記在長紀年曆9.15.0.0.0，即公元650年；記錄它的蒂卡爾31號碑立於公元751年，碑文回述百年前的敗績，因此這場戰爭是事後百年才被刻成石頭的。蒂卡爾此後再度停頓，直到公元692年前後重開王表、恢復立碑，這段中世紀空白期（Middle Classic hiatus）前後約一百三十一年。卡拉克穆爾的最後一件有紀年碑銘停在10.1.10.0.0，即公元859年，該城約在公元1050年前後完全無人居住。乾旱：古氣候研究把末期古典期的乾旱窗口定在公元六百至九百年之間，蒂卡爾水庫的沉積物顯示公元700至800年間有持續數百年的乾旱，其中七百五十年前後最為乾旱，恰好覆蓋卡拉克穆爾由盛轉衰的轉折。人口：考古學家按台基數量與居住區面積推估，蒂卡爾在古典期高峰的常住人口以萬計，常見推估落在四萬至十萬之間；卡拉克穆爾在七世紀的高峰亦是數萬量級。兵力、俘虜數與傷亡：瑪雅銘文從不記數目，只記擒獲、焚燒與占領，所以任何精確兵員數都是後人推估。至於月份，現存銘文只把事件定位在公元650年之內，具體月令無從考定，本卡的月份欄按年初計，並非出於史料記載。
dataEn: There are not many checkable numbers, but the following are hard evidence. Distances: roughly 76 kilometres from Caracol to Tikal, with Naranjo between them, about 42 kilometres from each. Dates: the campaign itself is recorded in the Long Count as 9.15.0.0.0, which is AD 650; the monument that records it, Stela 31 at Tikal, was raised in AD 751 and looks back a century on the defeat, so this war was only cut into stone a hundred years after it was fought. Tikal then stalled again and did not reopen its dynastic sequence and its monument-building until around AD 692, a Middle Classic hiatus of roughly 130 years. The last dated monument at Caracol stops at 10.1.10.0.0, AD 859, and the city stood completely deserted by about AD 1050. Drought: palaeoclimate work places the Terminal Classic drought window between AD 600 and 900, and the sediment in the Tikal reservoirs shows a multi-century dry period across AD 700 to 800, driest around the middle of the eighth century, which covers exactly the turn from Caracol's height to its collapse. Population: archaeologists estimate from the number of platform mounds and the extent of residential areas; Tikal at its Classic height is put at tens of thousands, commonly in the range of forty to a hundred thousand, and Caracol at its seventh-century height was also a settlement of tens of thousands. Troop strength, captives and losses: Maya inscriptions never give numbers, only captures, burnings and occupations, so every precise figure for the size of the armies is a later estimate. As for the month, the surviving inscriptions place the event only within the year 650, and the month cannot be established; the month field on this card counts from the start of the year and does not rest on a source.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是地位：卡拉克穆爾在公元562年用星戰擊敗蒂卡爾之後，儘管沒有徹底消化蒂卡爾，仍然成為佩滕盆地的新中心；而蒂卡爾在六世紀下半葉到七世紀上半葉逐步復甦，重新在盆地東緣取得影響力，把納蘭霍與周邊貿易線重新拉回自己一側，對卡拉克穆爾形成直接壓力。卡拉克穆爾必須在對方站穩之前給予致命一擊。第二層是北方的支撐：墨西哥卡拉克穆爾的蛇族王室正把勢力伸進佩滕，瓦卡高原的高階墓葬中出現帶特奧蒂瓦卡納風格的火葬遺存，說明北方的影響早已先一步抵達，而蛇族王室的出兵讓瓦卡一方有信心單獨吃掉佩滕盆地最大的城邦。第三層是生態與資源：古典期低地人口膨脹，燒荒與過度取水壓縮可用農地，兩座城邦都想把上游的水、盆地東緣的商路與高原運來的黑曜石變成自己的資源。於是這場戰爭從誰是宗主，變成誰能把對方從地圖上抹去，而公元650年的攻勢正是要抹去蒂卡爾的第一步。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The surface layer was status: after Caracol beat Tikal in the star war of AD 562, and even without finishing Tikal off, it became the new centre of the Peten basin; but Tikal recovered gradually between the later sixth and the first half of the seventh century, regaining influence on the eastern rim of the basin and pulling Naranjo and the surrounding trade routes back to its own side, which pressed directly on Caracol. Caracol had to deal a decisive blow before the other side consolidated. The second layer was northern support: the Snake royal house of the Mexican Calakmul was extending its reach into the Peten, and the high-status burials at the Vaca Plateau contain cremated remains in Teotihuacan style, showing that northern influence had already arrived ahead of the army; the Snake king's support gave the plateau city-state the confidence to swallow the largest city of the Peten on its own. The third layer was ecology and resources: population in the lowlands swelled during the Classic period, and slash-and-burn clearing and over-drawing of water shrank the farmland available; both city-states wanted the upstream water, the trade routes of the eastern basin and the obsidian brought down from the highlands to become their own. So the war turned from the question of who was overlord into the question of who could erase the other from the map, and the offensive of AD 650 was the first step in erasing Tikal.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，超出兩座城邦的勝負。對蒂卡爾而言，代價是第二次中斷：公元650年前後的敗績使它的古典期霸權告一段落，大廣場一帶的立碑與大型營建再度停擺；此前已因562年的星戰受挫的城邦，此後又要等上數十年才重新站起來。對卡拉克穆爾而言，650年是它的高點：它的人口密度、大型台形建築群、堤道系統與對盆地東緣的控制在七世紀達到頂峰，水蓮美洲豹的徽記被刻上蒂卡爾的石碑，這正是勝者的名字刻在被征服者城裡的典型場景。但高點之後緊接著崩落：末期古典期的乾旱與隨之而來的饑荒、病疫，疊加王位繼承的失序，使卡拉克穆爾的統治在七世紀末八世紀初迅速瓦解，公元695年蒂卡爾反過來打敗卡拉克穆爾，中部瑪雅低地的權力又回到蒂卡爾手上。對整個古典期史而言，這場戰爭還留下一件獨特的文獻：蒂卡爾31號碑是已知唯一一座記錄自身敗績的瑪雅石碑，碑面帶有極罕見的完整戰俘形象，讓學者得以從石頭上讀出這場沒有留下任何戰史的戰爭。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached beyond the fortunes of two city-states. For Tikal the price was a second interruption: the defeat around AD 650 closed a chapter of Classic-period supremacy, monument-raising and large construction in the Great Plaza stopped again, and a city-state already shaken by the star war of 562 would wait decades more before it stood up once more. For Caracol, 650 was the high point: population density, the great platform mounds, the causeway system and control over the eastern rim of the basin all peaked in the seventh century, and the water lily jaguar emblem was cut onto Tikal's own stelae, a classic scene in which the victor's name is carved in the city of the defeated. But the peak was followed immediately by collapse: the Terminal Classic drought, the famine and disease that came with it, and the disorder of royal succession together broke Caracol's rule in the late seventh and early eighth century, and in AD 695 Tikal in turn defeated Caracol, returning the authority of the central Maya lowlands to Tikal. For the history of the Classic period as a whole, the war left behind a unique document: Stela 31 at Tikal is the only known Maya stela that records a defeat of its own city, and its face carries an unusually complete image of a captive, which allows scholars to read a war that left no other account of itself.
result: 公元650年，卡拉克穆爾在卡爾通·希克斯率領下攻入蒂卡爾，以一次斧戰式的征服告終：蒂卡爾的城市遭到劫掠與破壞，它的古典期統治被中斷，勝方把自己的徽記刻在對方的石碑上。戰爭的勝負其實是雙向的：卡拉克穆爾靠這一仗登上佩滕盆地的頂峰，卻也把自己推到了乾旱與資源耗盡的臨界點上。往後數十年間，蒂卡爾始終沒有放棄盆地核心的合法性，公元692年前後重開王表、恢復立碑，公元695年在雙月卡威爾二世治下打敗卡拉克穆爾，重新奪回中部低地的宗主地位；公元736年更把自己的勢力越過佩滕，向北方的烏斯馬潘河流域延伸。卡拉克穆爾則一路走低：它最後一件有紀年的碑銘停在公元859年，城邦在公元1050年前後完全荒廢。於是這場戰爭留下一個殘酷的對稱，被公元650年征服的蒂卡爾活了下來並且復國，而公元650年的征服者卡拉克穆爾，最後走進了同一片叢林。
resultEn: In AD 650 Caracol, led by K'altuun Hix, marched into Tikal and ended in a ch'ak, a conquest: the city of Tikal was plundered and damaged, its Classic-period rule was interrupted, and the victors cut their own emblem onto the defeated side's stelae. The outcome was in fact two-sided: Caracol climbed to the summit of the Peten basin on the strength of this campaign, but it also pushed itself to the edge of drought and exhausted resources. For the decades that followed, Tikal never gave up its claim to the legitimacy of the basin's core; it reopened its dynastic sequence and resumed raising monuments around AD 692, and in AD 695, under the Double Moon, K'awil II, it defeated Caracol and took back the overlordship of the central lowlands, extending its influence past the Peten toward the Usumacinta river to the north in AD 736. Caracol went downhill from there: its last dated monument stops at AD 859, and the city lay completely abandoned by about AD 1050. So the war left a cruel symmetry behind: the Tikal conquered in AD 650 survived and came back, while Caracol, the conqueror of AD 650, ended up walking into the same forest.
